items.title: HRD: an integrated multi-omics resource for human reproduction and development
items.title_zh: HRD：人类生殖与发育的综合多组学资源
items.summary_zh: 摘要 人类生殖与发育是一个由遗传、分子和环境因素塑造的连续过程。然而，相关数据仍分散在公共存储库和文献中，限制了系统整合、分析和再利用。我们开发了人类生殖与发育数据库（HRD；http://www.inbirg.com/hrd/），这是一个综合多组学资源，组织与多个生殖、妊娠和发育背景相关的公开可用数据。HRD 1.0版包含814条组学记录，包括432条批量转录组、144条单细胞或单核转录组、156条表观基因组、52条代谢组和30条蛋白质组记录，以及702条临床试验记录、293条暴露-结局关联和779个带有 curated 表型关联的先导SNP。通过协调关键元数据并应用数据类型特定的分析工作流，HRD将组学数据、遗传关联、暴露-结局证据和临床试验数据纳入一个共同框架，以探索生殖和发育多个阶段的数据。该网站支持关键词搜索、组合筛选、基于类别的浏览、统计摘要和数据下载，并提供差异分析、功能富集

extra.description: Abstract Human reproduction and development span a continuum shaped by genetic, molecular, and environmental factors. However, relevant data remain dispersed across public repositories and the literature, limiting systematic integration, analysis, and reuse. We developed the Human Reproduction and Development Database (HRD; http://www.inbirg.com/hrd/), an integrated multi-omics resource that organizes publicly available data relevant to multiple reproductive, pregnancy, and developmental contexts. HRD version 1.0 contains 814 omics records, including 432 bulk transcriptomic, 144 single-cell or single-nucleus transcriptomic, 156 epigenomic, 52 metabolomic, and 30 proteomic records, together with 702 clinical trial records, 293 exposure-outcome associations, and 779 lead SNPs with curated phenotype associations. By harmonising key metadata and applying data-type-specific analysis workflows, HRD brings omics data, genetic associations, exposure-outcome evidence, and clinical trial data into a common framework for exploring data from multiple stages of reproduction and development. The website supports keyword search, combined filtering, category-based browsing, statistical summaries and data downloads, and provides interactive visualizations of differential analyses, functional enrichment, cell clustering, chromatin accessibility, peak annotation, regulatory networks, and cross-phenotype association plots. HRD supports the retrieval, comparison, and reuse of reproductive and developmental data and analysis results.

items.title: CALT-GNN: a graph neural network with cross-attention and long-tail experts for multi-omics cancer subtype classification
items.title_zh: CALT-GNN：一种用于多组学癌症亚型分类的交叉注意力和长尾专家图神经网络
items.summary_zh: 摘要 基于分子特征的癌症亚型分类对于表征肿瘤异质性、评估患者预后和支持精准治疗很重要。多组学整合提供了基因组、表观基因组、转录组和蛋白质组层面的互补分子信息。然而，多组学数据的高维性、复杂的跨组学关系和不平衡的亚型分布仍是主要挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出CALT-GNN，一种图神经网络框架，整合患者相似性图学习、基于交叉注意力的组学整合、长尾专家分类和可学习预测融合。该框架首先构建组学特异性患者相似性图，使用图卷积网络学习潜在患者表示，并通过相似性网络融合获得统一图。交叉注意力分支将CNA和DNA甲基化作为源模态，mRNA表达作为目标模态，建模互补关系。并行地，长尾专家分支使用主要和次要专家，配合原型引导路由，执行类别分布感知分类。两个分支的输出随后使用可学习全局权重组合。在八个TCGA多组学队列上的实验表明，CALT-GNN相对于代表性基线方法取得了有竞争力或可比的分类性能，并在对类别

extra.description: Abstract Cancer subtype classification based on molecular features is important for characterizing tumor heterogeneity, evaluating patient prognosis, and supporting precision treatment. Multi-omics integration provides complementary molecular information across genomic, epigenomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic levels. However, the high dimensionality of multi-omics data, complex cross-omics relationships, and imbalanced subtype distributions remain major challenges. To address these issues, we propose CALT-GNN, a graph neural network framework that integrates patient-similarity graph learning, cross-attention-based omics integration, long-tail expert classification, and learnable prediction fusion. The framework first constructs omics-specific patient-similarity graphs, learns latent patient representations using graph convolutional networks, and obtains a unified graph through similarity network fusion. A cross-attention branch models complementary relationships between CNA and DNA methylation as source modalities and mRNA expression as the target modality. In parallel, a long-tail expert branch uses Major and Minor Experts with prototype-guided routing to perform class-distribution-aware classification. The outputs of the two branches are subsequently combined using a learnable global weight. Experiments on eight TCGA multi-omics cohorts showed that CALT-GNN achieved competitive or comparable classification performance relative to representative baseline methods and stable performance on Macro-F1 and MCC, which are sensitive to class imbalance. Ablation and subtype-level analyses further supported the complementary contributions of cross-omics interaction modeling and adaptive long-tail expert routing, although the magnitude of the improvements varied across cohorts and subtypes. These results suggest that CALT-GNN provides a methodological framework for multi-omics cancer subtype classification under complex cross-omics relationships and imbalanced subtype distributions.

items.summary_zh: 细胞分割是空间转录组学中关键但标准化不足的步骤，直接影响细胞身份分配、空间组织和下游生物学解释。尽管空间转录组学技术快速发展，跨平台和生物学背景的分割方法系统评估仍然有限。在这里，我们基准测试了11种基于图像、基于转录组学和多模态的分割方法，涵盖由5种空间转录组学技术生成的15个数据集，跨越12种人类和小鼠组织类型。我们引入了生物学信息评估指标，量化分割质量、转录本回收、细胞组成、形态、表达纯度和空间组织。基准测试揭示了跨数据集、技术和评估标准的性能显著差异，突出了分割完整性、转录组保真度和生物学可解释性之间的权衡。跨技术分析进一步表明，分割选择关键性地塑造下游分析，包括细胞类型特异性、转录本污染和配体-受体推断。总之，我们的统一Nextflow流程为空间转录组学中分割的标准化评估和方法选择提供了可扩展的基础。

extra.description: Cell segmentation is a critical yet under-standardized step in spatial transcriptomics, directly affecting cell identity assignment, spatial organization and downstream biological interpretation. Despite rapid advances in spatial transcriptomics technologies, systematic evaluations of segmentation methods across platforms and biological contexts remain limited. Here we benchmark 11 image-based, transcriptomics-based and multimodal segmentation methods across 15 datasets generated by 5 spatial transcriptomics technologies, spanning 12 human and mouse tissue types. We introduce biologically informed evaluation metrics that quantify segmentation quality, transcript recovery, cell composition, morphology, expression purity and spatial organization. Benchmarking reveals substantial variation in performance across datasets, technologies and evaluation criteria, highlighting trade-offs among segmentation completeness, transcriptomic fidelity and biological interpretability. Cross-technology analyses further demonstrate that segmentation choice critically shapes downstream analyses, including cell-type specificity, transcript contamination and ligand-receptor inference. Together, our unified Nextflow pipeline provides a scalable foundation for standardized evaluation of segmentation and method selection in spatial transcriptomics.

items.title: 4D-atlas: a multi-species four-dimensional spatiotemporal transcriptomics database spanning development, regeneration, and disease

items.summary_zh: 摘要 四维（4D）空间转录组学同时捕捉三维（3D）组织结构与时间进程中的分子图谱，对于解析发育、再生和疾病进展等动态生物过程至关重要。在此，我们推出4D-atlas（https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/4D-Atlas 或 https://4d-atlas.bio-database.com/），这是首个公开可访问的、专注于多物种4D时空转录组图谱的数据库。4D-atlas收集并标准化了来自六个物种15个代表性数据集的1629个空间切片，涵盖88个不同时间点（每个数据集2–41个），包含超过2220万个细胞或空间位点，涵盖胚胎发育、组织再生和疾病进展。除数据收集外，4D-atlas提供七个交互式分析模块，支持对组织形态发生、空间基因模块、通路活性、调控网络、细胞间通讯、发育轨迹和时间表达模式进行4D（3D空间+时间）探索。通过统一的分析流程整合离散生物阶段的3D

extra.description: Abstract Four-dimensional (4D) spatial transcriptomics, which captures molecular landscapes across both three-dimensional (3D) tissue architecture and temporal progression, is essential for deciphering dynamic biological processes such as development, regeneration, and disease progression. Here, we present 4D-atlas (https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/4D-Atlas or https://4d-atlas.bio-database.com/), the first publicly accessible database dedicated to multi-species 4D spatiotemporal transcriptomic atlases. 4D-atlas collects and standardizes 1629 spatial slices spanning 88 distinct time points with 2–41 per dataset and over 22.2 million cells or spatial spots from 15 representative datasets across six species, encompassing embryonic development, tissue regeneration, and disease progression. Beyond data collection, 4D-atlas provides seven interactive analytical modules that enable 4D (3D space + time) exploration of tissue morphogenesis, spatial gene modules, pathway activities, regulatory networks, cell–cell communication, developmental trajectories, and temporal expression patterns. Using a unified analytical pipeline to integrate 3D spatial architecture and molecular information across discrete biological stages, 4D-atlas enables systematic investigation of tissue morphogenesis and dynamic regulatory programs across time and space.

items.title: scSpatial: an atlas for single-cell spatial omics
items.title_zh: scSpatial：单细胞空间组学图谱
items.summary_zh: 摘要 单细胞空间组学（SCSO）通过在单细胞分辨率下同时实现分子表征和空间定位，重塑了空间分析，为在原生生物背景下理解细胞身份和组织结构提供了洞见。通过整合空间坐标与分子谱和细胞身份，SCSO数据集已被广泛用于构建空间分辨的细胞图谱、表征疾病相关组织重塑以及绘制疾病相关细胞群体。然而，这些SCSO数据集仍分散于各独立出版物中，全面的SCSO资源仍然缺乏。因此，我们开发了scSpatial，一个具有专家策展细胞注释和高分辨率空间映射的SCSO图谱。当前版本的scSpatial策展了大规模SCSO数据集合，包含来自630个项目的1800多个组织切片，使用16种空间技术生成；提供超过2000万个空间分辨细胞，注释为173个标准化Cell Ontology类型；并提供SCSO定制分析和交互式可视化，包括空间基因表达图谱、细胞类型分布图、空间可变基因、基因表达相关性和通路级空间活性谱。scSpati

extra.description: Abstract Single-cell spatial omics (SCSO) has reshaped spatial profiling by enabling simultaneous molecular characterization and spatial mapping at single-cell resolution, providing insights into cellular identities and tissue architecture within native biological contexts. By integrating spatial coordinates with molecular profiles and cell identities, SCSO datasets have been widely used to construct spatially resolved cell atlases, characterize disease-associated tissue remodeling, and map disease-relevant cell populations. However, these SCSO datasets remain fragmented across individual publications, and comprehensive SCSO resources are still lacking. Here, scSpatial was therefore developed as an atlas for SCSO with expert-curated cell annotations and high-resolution spatial mappings. The current release of scSpatial curates a large-scale collection of SCSO data, comprising over 1800 tissue sections from 630 projects generated using 16 spatial technologies; provides >20 million spatially resolved cells annotated into 173 standardized Cell Ontology types; and offers SCSO-tailored analyses and interactive visualizations, including spatial gene expression atlases, cell type distribution maps, spatially variable genes, gene expression correlations, and pathway-level spatial activity profiles. scSpatial is freely accessible to all users without requiring login at https://idrblab.org/scspatial/.

items.title: OpenDVP: an experimental and computational framework for community-empowered deep visual proteomics.
items.title_zh: OpenDVP：一个由社区赋能的深度视觉蛋白质组学实验与计算框架。
items.summary_zh: 深度视觉蛋白质组学（DVP）是一种新兴方法，用于细胞类型特异性和空间分辨的蛋白质组学。然而，其广泛采用一直受限于社区驱动生态系统中缺乏开源端到端工作流。在此我们介绍 openDVP，一个用于可访问且可扩展 DVP 的实验与计算框架。OpenDVP 将开源图像分析工具（MCMICRO、QuPath 和 napari）与 scverse 格式（AnnData 和 SpatialData）结合，用于多组学整合。它提供两种工作流：一种无需图像分析专业知识的快速通道流程，以及一种纳入最先进图像预处理、分割和空间分析方法的 AI 驱动流程。我们将 openDVP 应用于三项档案组织研究（人类胎盘、早期肺癌和局部复发乳腺癌），将空间单细胞表型与探索性蛋白质组测量整合。最后，我们引入细胞邻域的深度蛋白质组分析，作为一种用于空间发现蛋白质组学的可扩展方法。

extra.description: Deep visual proteomics (DVP) is an emerging approach for cell-type-specific and spatially resolved proteomics. However, its broad adoption has been constrained by the lack of an open-source end-to-end workflow within a community-driven ecosystem. Here we introduce openDVP, an experimental and computational framework for accessible and scalable DVP. OpenDVP combines open-source image analysis tools (MCMICRO, QuPath and napari) with scverse formats (AnnData and SpatialData) for multiomics integration. It provides two workflows: a fast-track pipeline requiring no image analysis expertise, and an artificial intelligence-powered pipeline incorporating state-of-the-art methods for image preprocessing, segmentation and spatial analysis. We apply openDVP across three archival tissue studies (human placenta, early stage lung cancer and locally relapsed breast cancer), integrating spatial single-cell phenotypes with exploratory proteomic measurements. Finally, we introduce deep proteomic profiling of cellular neighborhoods as a scalable approach for spatial discovery proteomics.

items.title: CauTrigger: deciphering biological system state transitions by hierarchical causal decomposition.
items.title_zh: CauTrigger：通过分层因果分解破译生物系统状态转变。
items.summary_zh: 生物系统表现出复杂的层级调控，多层之间的相互作用控制状态之间的转变。识别这些状态转变背后的因果架构仍然具有挑战性，因为在观察数据中混杂因素会产生虚假关联。在此我们提出 CauTrigger，一种分层深度潜变量模型，整合 do-calculus 以识别潜在因果触发因素并预测跨多个调控层的扰动结果。通过分离因果和虚假潜因子，CauTrigger 递归重建 underlying 调控层级，并使从观察数据进行可解释推理成为可能。在具有多层调控结构的合成和真实世界数据集中，CauTrigger 在识别因果触发因素和预测系统级响应方面优于现有方法。应用于单细胞多组学和肠道微生物组数据集时，CauTrigger 优先考虑候选因果触发因素，并使用计算机扰动生成关于生物状态转变的可检验假设，并为状态导航的潜在策略提供信息。总之，这些结果确立了 CauTrigger 作为复杂生物系统中因果发现的通用框架。

extra.description: Biological systems exhibit complex hierarchical regulation, with interactions across multiple layers governing transitions between states. Identifying the causal architecture underlying these state transitions remains challenging because confounding can produce spurious associations in observational data. Here we present CauTrigger, a hierarchical deep latent variable model that integrates do-calculus to identify potential causal triggers and predict perturbation outcomes across multiple regulatory layers. By disentangling causal and spurious latent factors, CauTrigger recursively reconstructs the underlying regulatory hierarchy and enables interpretable reasoning from observational data. Across synthetic and real-world datasets with multilayer regulatory structures, CauTrigger outperforms existing methods in identifying causal triggers and forecasting system-level responses. Applied to single-cell multi-omics and gut microbiome datasets, CauTrigger prioritizes candidate causal triggers and uses in silico perturbations to generate testable hypotheses about biological state transitions and inform potential strategies for state navigation. Together, these results establish CauTrigger as a general-purpose framework for causal discovery in complex biological systems.

items.title: Stage-resolved multi-omics reveals broad developmental preservation and localized molecular remodeling in cold-shock-induced triploid fish embryos
items.title_zh: 阶段分辨的多组学揭示冷休克诱导三倍体鱼胚胎中广泛的发育保守性和局部分子重塑
items.summary_zh: 摘要 背景 基因组剂量增加可改变细胞和调控状态，但脊椎动物胚胎在全基因组剂量增加后如何维持协调的发育进程仍不清楚。结果 在此，我们研究了大黄鱼（Larimichthys crocea）冷休克诱导三倍体胚胎发生过程中的发育、转录组和DNA甲基化模式。三倍体胚胎的DNA含量约高1.51倍，并在与二倍体对照相当的时间达到主要发育阶段。在八个阶段中，发育阶段而非倍性主导了全局RNA-seq变异，表明相对转录组组成广泛保守。逐阶段比较识别出局部转录差异主要集中于囊胚期和心跳期。阶段×倍性交互分析揭示了涉及RNA加工、胚胎模式形成、细胞外基质组织和收缩发育的独特发育表达轨迹。三个阶段的全基因组亚硫酸氢盐测序揭示了广泛且双向的区域甲基化差异。相对于可分析的基因组窗口，差异甲基化区域在基因组背景中显示非随机富集，尤其在CpG岛和启动子中富集强烈。然而，启动子、基因体、外显子和内含子背景中的甲基化-表达相关

extra.description: Abstract Background Increased genome dosage can alter cellular and regulatory states, yet how vertebrate embryos maintain coordinated developmental progression following a whole-genome dosage increase remains unclear. Results Here, we examined developmental, transcriptomic, and DNA methylation patterns during cold-shock-induced triploid embryogenesis in large yellow croaker ( Larimichthys crocea ). Triploid embryos exhibited approximately 1.51-fold higher DNA content and reached major developmental stages at times comparable with diploid controls. Across eight stages, developmental stage rather than ploidy dominated global RNA-seq variation, indicating broad preservation of relative transcriptome composition. Stage-wise comparisons identified localized transcriptional differences concentrated primarily at the blastula and heartbeat stages. Stage-by-ploidy interaction analysis revealed distinct developmental expression trajectories involving RNA processing, embryonic patterning, extracellular matrix organization, and contractile development. Whole-genome bisulfite sequencing at three stages revealed extensive and bidirectional regional methylation differences. Relative to analyzable genomic windows, differentially methylated regions showed non-random enrichment across genomic contexts, including particularly strong enrichment in CpG islands and promoters. However, methylation–expression correlations across promoter, gene-body, exonic, and intronic contexts were uniformly weak. Among RNA-testable differentially methylated genes, only seven genes at the blastula stage and two at the heartbeat stage were also differentially expressed, and these overlaps were not greater than expected under independence. Conclusions Cold-shock-induced triploid embryos therefore retain broadly preserved developmental progression and relative transcriptome organization while exhibiting localized transcriptional differences and extensive, genomically structured methylation remodeling. The limited same-stage correspondence between methylation and expression indicates that regional methylation differences are not broadly associated with concurrent transcriptional divergence in bulk embryos.

items.title: scTraitReg: a single-cell multi-omic database of trait-relevant transcription factor eRegulons
items.title_zh: scTraitReg：性状相关转录因子eRegulon的单细胞多组学数据库
items.summary_zh: 摘要 全基因组关联研究（GWAS）识别与人类疾病和疾病相关性状相关的位点，但与这些信号相关的调控因子和细胞背景仍难以解析。我们提出scTraitReg，一个单细胞分辨率的性状相关转录因子（TF）eRegulon数据库——包含TF及其靶基因和连锁顺式调控区域。scTraitReg整合了655套 curated GWAS汇总统计，覆盖122个医学主题词（MeSH）疾病术语，以及111个人类单细胞多组学数据集，这些数据集在同一细胞中分析RNA和染色质可及性。该资源涵盖34种组织、252种细胞类型、2 081 538个细胞和2208对 curated GWAS—单细胞分析配对。在这些分析中，它包含886个调控因子的2 840 939条TF–细胞类型记录；67 666条记录满足全部三项标准——细胞类型特异性、遗传相关性和性状相关调控子评分——并被纳入候选性状相关eRegulon记录。每条记录链接到T

extra.description: Abstract Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) identify loci associated with human diseases and disease-related traits, but the regulators and cellular contexts linked to these signals remain difficult to resolve. We present scTraitReg, a database of trait-relevant transcription factor (TF) eRegulons—TFs with their target genes and linked cis-regulatory regions—at single-cell resolution. scTraitReg integrates 655 sets of curated GWAS summary statistics covering 122 Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) disease terms with 111 human single-cell multi-omic datasets profiling RNA and chromatin accessibility in the same cells. The resource spans 34 tissues, 252 cell types, 2 081 538 cells, and 2208 curated GWAS—single-cell analysis pairs. Across these analyses, it contains 2 840 939 TF–cell-type records for 886 regulators; 67 666 records met all three criteria—cell-type specificity, genetic relevance, and the trait-associated regulon score—and were included as candidate trait-relevant eRegulon records. Each record links to the TF—target regulatory network with its cis-regulatory regions, cell-type-resolved evidence, per-cell regulon module scores, and target-gene enrichment, all available as downloadable tables. Users can search by disease, tissue, cell type, or regulator and examine these associations through interactive visualizations. scTraitReg thus provides a searchable and reusable resource linking genetic associations to cell-type-specific regulatory programs, and is freely available at https://www.sctraitreg.bio/.

items.title: SADRP: A structurally aware multi-modal framework for drug response prediction
items.title_zh: SADRP：一个用于药物反应预测的结构感知多模态框架
items.summary_zh: 动机：预测不同癌症样本的药物敏感性是个性化治疗和药物发现中的基本挑战。该任务需要对药物和癌细胞系特征进行全面表征。当前方法往往无法充分捕捉药物化合物的复杂结构特征和相互作用，也难以整合来自同一样本的多组学特征，限制了其特征表示能力。因此，需要能够以统一方式联合建模分子结构特征和多模态细胞背景的建模框架。结果：我们提出SADRP，一个用于药物反应预测的结构感知多模态框架，旨在建模复杂分子结构和多组学数据。对于药物表示，SADRP结合了最短距离路径（SDP）编码和边编码，以捕捉拓扑关系和键类型化学语义。对于细胞系分析，多视图交互编码器整合基因表达和DNA甲基化，捕捉跨组学协同互补性。SADRP始终优于最先进的方法，同时还识别出潜在的治疗候选物和生物标志物，提供机制洞察并支持药物发现和个性化医疗中的应用。

extra.description: Motivation Predicting drug sensitivity across diverse cancer samples is a fundamental challenge in personalized therapy and drug discovery. This task requires comprehensive characterization of both drug and cancer cell line features. Current approaches often fail to fully capture the complex structural characteristics and interactions of drug compounds and struggle to integrate multi-omics features derived from the same sample, limiting their feature representation capacity. Consequently, there is a need for modeling frameworks that can jointly model molecular structural features and multi-modal cellular contexts in a unified manner. Results We present SADRP, a structurally aware multi-modal framework for drug response prediction, designed to model complex molecular structures and multi-omics data. For drug representation, SADRP incorporates Shortest Distance Path (SDP) encoding and edge encoding to capture both topological relationships and bond-type chemical semantics. For cell line profiling, a multi-view interactive encoder integrates gene expression and DNA methylation, capturing cross-omics synergistic complementarity. SADRP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, while also identifying potential therapeutic candidates and biomarkers, providing mechanistic insights and supporting applications in drug discovery and personalized medicine.

items.title: ImmunEscpMap: a gene-centered knowledgebase for immune escape in cancer and viral infection
items.title_zh: ImmunEscpMap：一个以基因为中心的癌症和病毒感染免疫逃逸知识库
items.summary_zh: 摘要 肿瘤利用免疫逃逸来逃避消除，而病毒重塑宿主免疫以复制或持续存在。然而，解释这些过程的证据分散在数据库、文献和组学分析中，阻碍了基因优先排序。为解决此问题，我们开发了ImmunEscpMap，一个以基因为中心的知识库，在统一的免疫逃逸框架内连接癌症和病毒感染证据。当前版本包含55,711条基因-证据记录（来自37,193个唯一PMID的53,911条PubMed记录和来自709个登录号的1,800条基因表达综合数据库记录），代表667个不同来源基因（癌症中657个，病毒感染中571个，561个共享）。证据组织为八种免疫逃逸机制和14种病毒背景，癌症分支整合多组学和临床结果，病毒分支将机制锚点与感染相关证据分开。网络界面支持标识符搜索、背景浏览、文献视图、交互式基因页面和批量下载。ImmunEscpMap可在https://iescpemap.cqmu.edu.cn/免费获取，提供可追溯

extra.description: Abstract Tumors exploit immune escape to evade elimination, whereas viruses remodel host immunity to replicate or persist. However, evidence to interpret these processes is fragmented across databases, literature, and omics analyses, hindering gene prioritization. To address this, we developed ImmunEscpMap, a gene-centered knowledgebase connecting cancer and viral-infection evidence within a unified immune-escape framework. The current release contains 55 711 gene-evidence records (53 911 PubMed records from 37 193 unique PMIDs and 1800 Gene Expression Omnibus records across 709 accessions) representing 667 distinct source genes (657 in cancer, 571 in viral infection, and 561 shared). Evidence is organized into eight immune-escape mechanisms and 14 viral contexts, with the cancer branch integrating multi-omics and clinical outcomes, and the viral branch separating mechanistic anchors from infection-associated evidence. The web interface supports identifier search, context browsing, literature views, interactive gene pages, and bulk downloads. ImmunEscpMap is freely available at https://iescpemap.cqmu.edu.cn/, providing a traceable cross-domain map to prioritize candidates and guide follow-up experiments.

items.title: Computational deconvolution of drug sensitivity via single-cell–to–bulk transcriptome mapping
items.title_zh: 通过单细胞到 bulk 转录组映射进行药物敏感性的计算去卷积
items.summary_zh: 基础研究和生物医学研究中常规进行的分析通常报告来自异质细胞混合物的聚合信号。这些混合物反映了其来源组织和器官固有的解剖和功能复杂性。此类 bulk 测量掩盖了细胞特异性信号，从而阻碍了对 underlying 生物过程的准确解读。在此，我们介绍 CLIMB 和 CLIFF，一个两步机器学习框架，将 bulk RNA-seq 去卷积为细胞类型组成和表达，然后将 bulk 药物敏感性测量解析为细胞亚型和单细胞特异性谱。我们首先使用实验已知细胞类型比例的白血病细胞系体外混合物验证 CLIMB，然后将验证扩展到基于独立 scRNA-seq 参考构建的大规模跨数据集伪 bulk 分析，涵盖两种疾病背景和五种癌症类型——模拟实际应用中遇到的参考到目标不匹配——并表明 CLIMB 准确推断 bulk 样本的细胞组成，优于最先进的 bulk 去卷积方法。我们强调 CLIMB 在急性髓系白血病中的有效性，它

extra.description: Analyses routinely conducted in both fundamental research and biomedical studies often report aggregate signals derived from heterogeneous mixtures of cells. These mixtures reflect the intrinsic anatomical and functional complexity of the tissues and organs from which they are derived. Such bulk measurements obscure cell-specific signals, thereby hindering accurate interpretation of the underlying biological processes. Here, we introduce CLIMB and CLIFF, a two-step machine-learning framework that deconvolves bulk RNA-seq into cell-type composition and expression, and then resolves bulk drug sensitivity measurements into cell subtype- and single-cell-specific profiles. We first validate CLIMB using in-vitro mixtures of leukemic cell lines with experimentally known cell-type proportions, then extend this validation to large-scale, cross-dataset pseudo-bulk analyses built from independent scRNA-seq references across two disease contexts and five cancer types — mimicking the reference-to-target mismatches encountered in real applications — and show that CLIMB accurately infers the cellular composition of bulk samples, outperforming state-of-the-art bulk deconvolution methods. We emphasize CLIMB’s effectiveness in acute myeloid leukemia, where it offers highly accurate estimation of leukemic stem cell fractions across three test datasets and three patient cohorts. We then validate CLIFF, our algorithm for estimating cell subtype- and single-cell-specific drug sensitivity, first on the same in-vitro cell line mixtures using experimentally measured drug responses, and then through in-depth, realistic-scale pseudo-bulk simulations. We applied our deconvolution strategy to the beatAML cohort dataset, currently the most extensive database of ex-vivo drug screening data. This analysis generated a cell subtype–resolved drug sensitivity landscape for 121 compounds, revealing multiple compounds putatively active against leukemic stem cells, including midostaurin, A-674563, SNS-032, and foretinib. Collectively, our work introduces a general computational framework for resolving bulk functional measurements at cell-type and single-cell resolution, providing an attractive new computational tool for drug development and precision medicine.

extra.description: Abstract Background Metabarcoding data generated from 16S rRNA and internal transcribed spacer (ITS) amplicon sequencing are inherently compositional, with observed abundances representing relative rather than absolute information. Ignoring this compositional structure can lead to spurious results in downstream analyses. In addition, multi-cohort studies frequently suffer from batch effects arising from differences in sample processing or sequencing platforms, which may confound true biological signals if not properly addressed. Despite the availability of multiple microbiome analysis platforms, these analytical considerations are not always incorporated together as central components of user-accessible workflows. Results We developed CoMeDA, an integrated web-based platform that treats the compositional structure of metabarcoding data and batch effects as coordinated components of a single analytical workflow. The platform supports both raw FASTQ files and pre-classified taxa tables, making it compatible with both short-read and long-read sequencing technologies. CoMeDA performs zero handling through probabilistic estimation and applies centered log-ratio (CLR) transformation as the default normalization strategy, followed by automated batch effect correction that removes technical variation while preserving biological signals. Downstream analyses, comprising diversity assessment using compositionally appropriate metrics, differential abundance analysis with effect size estimation, co-occurrence network inference, and functional prediction for both bacterial and fungal communities, are performed within the same compositional framework. CoMeDA also implements split-CLR transformation for cross-dataset analyses, enabling cross-kingdom and paired-condition correlation analyses while reducing spurious correlations introduced by directly combining datasets with different compositional structures. Using simulated datasets and a mock community with known ground truth, we evaluated the contribution of individual analytical components, the behavior of the automated batch-correction strategy, and taxonomic classification accuracy. We further reanalyzed a published multi-cohort gout dataset, a pediatric Crohn’s disease bacterial-fungal dataset, and a PacBio long-read periodontitis dataset. Using these datasets, CoMeDA recovered biologically coherent patterns while also highlighting additional literature-supported findings across different study designs. Conclusions CoMeDA provides a compositionally coherent workflow in which normalization, batch correction, and downstream analysis follow a consistent analytical logic. The platform features an interactive web interface and requires no programming expertise. CoMeDA is freely available online without registration, and a standalone Docker image is provided for local deployment.

items.title: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.title_zh: 基于多智能体深度强化学习的SD-IoT控制器部署
items.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

items.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。

extra.description:
<p<随着云边端协同计算与物联网技术的深度融合，动态异构网络中的海量终端已成为网络安全体系中的核心防护对象。这些智能终端在持续运行过程中产生网络流量、工控传感日志等多元时间序列数据，承载着终端行为的完整语义信息。因此，对此类时间序列数据进行精准分类是实现终端威胁检测的关键技术。然而，终端异质性引发的数据分布不均衡问题，使现有时序分类模型面临三重挑战：1）受限于固定分辨率的处理范式，模型难以捕捉不同时间尺度下的多粒度威胁特征；2）现有方法通常将所有分辨率特征映射至统一高维空间，忽视了不同时间分辨率在特征维度分布上的内在差异，导致噪声引入与特征冗余，制约了模型在计算资源受限的边缘终端上的部署适配能力；3）使用多分辨率进行联合推理，各分辨率分支的特征提取与融合过程带来显著的计算与存储开销，加剧了轻量化部署与高精度检测之间的固有矛盾。为了解决时间分辨率与特征维度适配的问题，提出了面向动态异构网络的自适应多分辨率表示学习（adaptive multi-resolution representation learning，AdaMRL）模型，实现了时间分辨率与特征维度的双向对齐解耦。首先，构建了多分辨率嵌套表征架构，提出多分辨率与嵌套维度自适应匹配机制，为每个时间分辨率独立配备嵌套表示学习层，自动选择最优的维度进行嵌套表示学习；其次，提出了多分辨率联合损失监督机制，在训练阶段对各分辨率表征进行同步约束，增强跨分辨率特征的鲁棒性并加快模型收敛；最后，设计了自适应维度选择与集成策略，在推理阶段为不同分辨率动态匹配最优特征维度，并通过软投票机制实现协同决策。在10个UEA多变量时间序列基准数据集与工业物联网边缘安全基准数据集Edge-IIoTset上的广泛实验表明，AdaMRL达到了当前先进的分类性能。与基准模型相比，所提方法平均分类准确率提升0.78个百分点，并在最佳自适应配置下将冗余特征参数计算量降低27.3%，在检测精度与计算效率之间实现了有效平衡，为边缘异质终端的实时安全防护提供了有力支撑。</p<


计算机研究与发展. 2026 63(10): 2632-2649.

items.title: 基于双重异常感知的时间序列异常检测
items.title_zh: 基于双重异常感知的时间序列异常检测
items.summary_zh:
<p<时间序列的异常检测在金融风控、故障诊断等领域中有着重要的应用价值，其关键在于构建能够有效区分正常与异常模式的表征空间。然而时间序列内在的特点以及异常的稀缺性，导致学习具有强判别能力的表征映射函数颇为困难，且泛化能力受限。与此同时，对比表示学习通过构建清晰可区分的样本实例的表征空间，为时序异常检测提供了更为自然且富有前景的解决方案。鉴于此，设计了基于双重异常感知的Transformer模型（DAT），通过异常注入和异常感知的手段，使DAT提前捕获异常样本的复杂特征。此外，通过结合上下文对比损失函数指导双分支学习正常样本与异常样本之间更本质、更具区分度的语义特征。实验在5个公开数据集上进行验证，并与21种基线模型进行对比。结果表明DAT在公共数据集上优于基线模型的平均性能，甚至在MSL和PSM数据集上能够达到SOTA。</p<

items.title: 融合动态原型与自监督迁移学习的跨域图异常检测
items.title_zh: 融合动态原型与自监督迁移学习的跨域图异常检测
items.summary_zh: <p<跨域图异常检测旨在利用源域图中的正常与异常样本信息，在标注稀缺的目标域图上实现有效的异常识别。然而，源域与目标域之间通常存在显著的图结构差异与特征分布偏移，导致源域知识难以有效迁移至目标域，限制了跨域泛化能力。此外，目标域缺乏标注信息，易引发训练过程中的决策边界模糊和预测不稳定问题。为解决上述问题，提出了一种融合动态原型与自监督迁移学习的跨域图异常检测方法。首先，基于源域中的正常与异常样本构建语义原型，并结合双向引导策略，实现源域原型与目标域节点在共享语义空间中的知识对齐，从而缓解跨域图之间的分布偏移。为进一步增强原型的稳定性与语义判别性，引入指数移动平均机制实现原型的动态更新；随后，通过最小化目标域节点嵌入的熵值，增强特征表示的区分度，以缓解决策边界模糊问题；最后，综合利用源域模型与无监督方法在目标域数据上生成异常评分的伪标签，并筛选高置信度样本作为弱监

items.title_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统,也叫智能体操作系统,是整合大模型、工具资源以及多智能体协同的核心平台,目前正逐渐成为推动通用人工智能发展的一个关键研究方向。对智能体操作系统领域的研究进展进行了系统梳理,首先从基础理论着手,回顾了多种大模型的演进情况以及智能体和传统操作系统领域的进展;接着,围绕典型体系结构,如AIOS等,阐述了其分层架构与模块化设计是怎样达成资源管理与智能调度的。进一步地,明确了当前智能体操作系统在上下文整合、扩展性以及安全性等方面面临的技术挑战,同时也提出了未来借助轻量化设计、自监督学习机制以及动态调度算法来提升多智能体协作效率。该研究的主要贡献为,将那些分散的研究给予整合,促使技术框架变得更为明晰,并指出了智能体操作系统对新兴体系以及行业定制化实践覆盖不全面的情况。未来的研究需要侧重推动跨域智能体操作系统自我进化的能力,并且加快其在各个领域的落地等。

items.title: An autoencoder outperforms two transformers on prediction of gene expression from chromatin accessibility
items.title_zh: 自编码器在从染色质可及性预测基因表达上优于两个 transformer
items.summary_zh: 从染色质可及性预测 RNA 丰度的模型很少在相同特征、目标和指标下比较。我们在来自 19 项人类研究的 126,604 个配对单核图谱上构建了一个基准，共享 50,000 个峰和 3,185 个基因的词表、十个 5x2 交叉验证折和一个评分目标，并在 70 次训练运行中比较了七个已实现流程和两个参考预测器；每个流程保留自己的输入归一化和原生训练目标。基于双变分自编码器的 scButterfly-B 流程在所有六十个配对折比较中，在每基因和细胞内 Spearman 相关上优于所有 transformer 流程，包括自回归 Perceiver 模型（Omic Translator）和无支持重构的 Cisformer，训练时间短 3.8 倍。Transformer 流程在细胞内轮廓形状上差距为 0.02-0.04，但在每基因相关上落后 0.10-0.24。在两个留出细胞类型上每基因相关较低；对照

extra.description: Models that predict RNA abundance from chromatin accessibility are rarely compared under the same features, targets and metrics. We built one benchmark on 126,604 paired single-nucleus profiles from 19 human studies with a shared vocabulary of 50,000 peaks and 3,185 genes, ten 5x2 cross-validation folds and one scoring target, and compared seven implemented pipelines and two reference predictors across 70 trained runs; each pipeline keeps its own input normalisation and native training target. The scButterfly-B pipeline, built on dual variational autoencoders, outperformed every transformer pipeline, including an autoregressive Perceiver model (Omic Translator) and a support-free reformulation of Cisformer, on per-gene and within-cell Spearman correlation in all sixty paired fold comparisons, with 3.8 times shorter training. Transformer pipelines come within 0.02-0.04 on within-cell profile shape but lag by 0.10-0.24 on per-gene correlation. On two withheld cell types per-gene correlation is low; controls show the podocyte values are typical of within-type correlation for seen cell types of the same size, whereas Paneth values match a cell-agnostic shuffle for every Omic Translator arm. Within the transformer family, prespecified ablations show the Perceiver encoder was worth +0.0439 in within-donor per-gene correlation over full self-attention, a chromosome-aware genomic attention prior reduced it by 0.0096 (exact donor-level sign-flip test, Holm-adjusted p = 1.2e-4), and decoder output order had no detectable effect. A training-mean profile reaches 0.314 within-cell correlation with no input and a constant at the true expressed-gene positions reaches 0.996 per-gene correlation, so oracle-support protocols are reported only as diagnostics. Code, results and an audited release are provided.

items.title: Spatially Informed and Direction Sensitive Representation Learning for Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: 面向空间转录组学的空间信息感知和方向敏感表示学习
items.summary_zh: 细胞状态由内在基因表达程序和细胞所在的空间微环境共同塑造。空间转录组学使这一背景变得可测量，但有效的表示学习需要同时捕获空间信息分子信号和细胞间组织。现有方法只能部分解决这些挑战：传统基因选择可能忽略空间结构化信号，而编码细胞-细胞关系的方法通常要么将细胞的微环境简化为仅邻近性，丢弃方向，要么依赖与任意组织框架绑定的绝对坐标。因此，具有相似邻居距离但不同空间组织的细胞可能获得过于相似的表示，尽管它们经历着塑造其细胞状态的不同生物背景。我们介绍Tessera，一个空间表示学习框架，同时解决分子选择和细胞背景问题。Tessera将空间信息基因选择与几何归纳偏置相结合，将每个细胞置于其局部组织环境中。通过建模相对细胞-细胞关系，Tessera具有平移不变性同时保留方向，允许邻近细胞根据其空间背景和细胞状态做出不同贡献。在留出组织和技术上，Tessera在表示质量上优于现有空间基础模型，并零样本泛

extra.description: Cellular states are shaped by both intrinsic gene expression programs and the spatial microenvironment in which cells reside. Spatial transcriptomics makes this context measurable, but effective representation learning requires capturing both spatially informative molecular signals and intercellular organization. Existing approaches address these challenges only partially: conventional gene selection can overlook spatially structured signals, while methods for encoding cell-cell relationships often either reduce a cell's microenvironment to proximity alone, discarding direction, or rely on absolute coordinates tied to an arbitrary tissue frame. Consequently, cells with similar neighbor distances but distinct spatial organization may receive overly similar representations, despite experiencing different biological contexts that shape their cellular states. We introduce Tessera, a spatial representation learning framework that addresses both molecular selection and cellular context. Tessera combines spatially informed gene selection with a geometric inductive bias that contextualizes each cell within its local tissue environment. By modeling relative cell-cell relationships, Tessera is translation-invariant while preserving direction, allowing neighboring cells to contribute differently according to their spatial context and cellular state. Across held-out tissues and technologies, Tessera outperforms existing spatial foundation models in representation quality and generalizes zero-shot to contexts up to $16\times$ larger than those seen during training.

items.title: GOLDEN: Gene expression and allele-informed decomposition for genetic heterogeneity in spatial transcriptomic data
items.title_zh: GOLDEN：空间转录组数据中遗传异质性的基因表达与等位基因知情分解
items.summary_zh: 动机 空间转录组学（ST）能够探索细胞相互作用，包括免疫反应。然而，当前方法依赖病理学家，在解决遗传异质性方面存在局限，即存在包含非克隆细胞的微环境，包括胎盘或同种异体移植组织。解读这些个体间混合仍然具有挑战性。结果 为了解读ST中的个体间异质性，我们开发了GOLDEN（基因表达与等位基因知情分解用于遗传异质性），它涉及一个等位基因感知的多任务网络，将spot级表达编码为共享潜在表示。结合等位基因特征，双头分类spot身份（目标、非目标或混合）并估计目标比例。我们利用半同基因单细胞图谱构建了具有spot级真实标签的合成ST数据。对于这些合成基准，GOLDEN实现了可靠的去卷积，在比例估计中具有高相关性（Pearson's r = 0.977）和低误差（平均绝对误差（MAE）= 0.045），并在真实世界ST中具有一致的预测。这些预测经过了遗传验证。使用GOLDEN，解决spot级遗传异质性

extra.description: Motivation Spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables exploration of cellular interactions, including immune responses. However, current methods rely on pathologists, with limitations in addressing genetic heterogeneity, where niches harboring nonclonal cells, including placental or allograft tissues, are present. Deciphering these interindividual mixtures remains challenging. Results For deciphering interindividual heterogeneity in ST, we developed GOLDEN (Gene expressiOn and aLlele-informed DEcomposition for geNetic heterogeneity), which involves an allele-aware multitask network that encodes spot-level expressions into shared latent representations. Incorporating allele features, dual heads classify spot identity (target, nontarget, or mixed) and estimate target fractions. We utilized synthetic ST data with spot-level ground truth using semiallogeneic single-cell profiles. For these synthetic benchmarks, GOLDEN achieved reliable deconvolution, with high correlation (Pearson's r = 0.977) and low error (mean absolute error (MAE) = 0.045) in fraction estimation and consistent predictions across real-world STs. These predictions were genetically validated. Using GOLDEN, resolving spot-level genetic heterogeneity is feasible. Availability and implementation GOLDEN and the simulation code for ST are available at https://github.com/othertics/GOLDEN.

items.title: Predicting cell-state-specific gene regulation from DNA across species
items.title_zh: 从DNA跨物种预测细胞状态特异性基因调控
items.summary_zh: DNA编码细胞表型，但相同的DNA序列在每个细胞类型、发育阶段和活动状态中被不同地解读。现有的深度学习模型只解决了这个谜题的一半：序列到功能模型读取DNA但将细胞状态视为固定标签，而单细胞基础模型表示细胞状态但不表示序列。我们开发了Bolero，一个序列到功能模型，其参数以图谱规模细胞状态嵌入和其他生物变量为条件，从DNA预测细胞状态特异性染色质可及性和转录本丰度。在来自六个哺乳动物33个数据集的1070万个细胞上训练，Bolero匹配或超越了专门模型，并解析了密切相关细胞状态之间的调控差异，包括皮层区域和发育梯度。外推细胞状态嵌入将Bolero的预测扩展到训练中不存在的细胞状态。细胞状态条件化促进了将非编码变异的影响追踪到它们作用的细胞类型。使用AP-1活性评分作为进一步的连续条件化轴，Bolero预测了活动调控的染色质变化，而无需实际刺激数据。在人类细胞类型中，我们重建了预测AP-1反

extra.description: DNA encodes the cell's phenotype, but the same DNA sequence is interpreted differently in every cell type, developmental stage, and activity state. Existing deep-learning models solve only half of this puzzle: sequence-to-function models read DNA but treat cell state as a fixed label, while single-cell foundation models represent cell state but not sequence. We developed Bolero, a sequence-to-function model whose parameters condition on atlas-scale cell-state embeddings and additional biological variables to predict cell-state-specific chromatin accessibility and transcript abundance from DNA. Trained on 10.7 million cells from 33 datasets across six mammals, Bolero matched or exceeded specialised models and resolved regulatory differences between closely related cell states, including cortical regional and developmental gradients. Extrapolating cell-state embeddings extended Bolero's predictions to cell states that are absent from training. Cell-state conditioning facilitated tracing of the effects of non-coding variants to the cell types in which they act. Using an AP-1 activity score as a further continuous conditioning axis, Bolero predicted activity-regulated chromatin changes without requiring actual stimulation data. Across human cell types, we reconstructed the cooperative grammar of motif identity and spacing underlying predicted AP-1 responses. Bolero further predicted cell-type-specific chromatin accessibility and AP-1 responses in species excluded from training, extending comparative genomics from sequence conservation to predicted functional conservation. Across 84 mammals, we found that predicted AP-1 responses were less conserved than chromatin accessibility at cis-regulatory elements, driven by the human-specific sequence variants on AP-1 and cooperating motifs. By combining reference genomes with reference cell atlases, Bolero allowed genome sequences, either native or mutated, to be queried across cell states, perturbations, and different species for their chromatin and expression signatures.

items.title: gpuGEM: GPU-based linear optimisation of genome-scale metabolic models
items.title_zh: gpuGEM：基于GPU的基因组尺度代谢模型线性优化
items.summary_zh: 摘要：基因组尺度代谢模型在重复优化工作流中日益挑战CPU线性规划求解器。我们提出gpuGEM，一个使用NVIDIA cuOpt进行基于GPU的GEM优化的开源Python库，具有针对HiGHS和Gurobi验证的尺寸自适应设置。在涵盖四个数量级问题规模的十个模型基准套件中，gpuGEM相对于每个模型更快的HiGHS对偶单纯形和内点法实现了1.1倍至94倍的加速。gpuGEM在十个模型中的三个上也优于Gurobi，加速为1.6倍至2.5倍。在候选基因优先级工作流中，gpuGEM将端到端查询时间从41秒减少到21秒。可用性与实现：gpuGEM在MIT许可证下发布于https://github.com/Digital-Metabolic-Twin-Centre/gpuGEM和PyPI（pip install gpugem）。存档版本（v0.1.2）可在https://zenodo.org/rec

extra.description: Summary: Genome-scale metabolic models increasingly challenge CPU linear-programming solvers in repeated-optimisation workflows. We present gpuGEM, an open-source Python library for GPU-based GEM optimisation using NVIDIA cuOpt, with size-adaptive settings validated against HiGHS and Gurobi. Across a ten-model benchmark suite spanning four orders of magnitude in problem size, gpuGEM achieved speed-ups of 1.1x to 94x relative to the faster of the HiGHS dual-simplex and interior-point methods for each model. gpuGEM also outperformed Gurobi on three of ten models, with speed-ups of 1.6x to 2.5x. In a candidate-gene prioritisation workflow, gpuGEM reduced end-to-end query time from 41 s to 21 s. Availability and Implementation: gpuGEM is released under the MIT licence at https://github.com/Digital-Metabolic-Twin-Centre/gpuGEM and on PyPI (pip install gpugem). An archived release(v0.1.2) is available at https://zenodo.org/records/23422813. gpuGEM requires an NVIDIA GPU, Python 3.11 or later, CUDA 12 and cuOpt 26.6 or later. cuOpt requires a GPU with Volta architecture or newer (compute capability 7.0 or newer). Contact: ronan.mt.fleming@gmail.com Supplementary information: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
items.title_zh: OmicsBench：AI智能体在研究级生物信息学上的长时程多轮基准
items.summary_zh: 计算生物学家越来越多地将大量分析委托给AI智能体进行长时程、多轮会话，但大多数智能体生物信息学能力基准只提出单一短任务和单次提示。我们提出OmicsBench，一个面向AI智能体的长时程、多轮生物信息学基准。其97个任务各自将依赖子任务连接成有向无环图，总共662个底层子任务。每个子任务作为一个用户轮次提出，并针对答案键进行确定性评分，对错误答案提供可选的上下文反馈。在三种框架上的12个模型中，最慢的智能体平均每任务耗时3.6小时，没有任何组合接近饱和该基准，无上下文反馈时平均得分为0.43至0.57（满分1），有反馈时为0.54至0.67。多轮评估还揭示了单次提示无法发现的行为，因为智能体在依赖早期子任务的子任务上得分较低，而上下文反馈帮助智能体挽回部分损失。由于确定性评分无法定性说明智能体如何失败，我们还引入了一个无监督失败模式发现流程，用于描述、嵌入和聚类智能体的失败尝试，以揭示涌现

extra.description: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend on earlier subtasks, and in-context feedback helps agents recover some of that loss. Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes. Applied to OmicsBench, this pipeline exposes qualitative shortcomings in how agents carry out bioinformatics analyses, ranging from agents applying their own statistical filters in place of the specified ones to agents writing whole answers from memory.

items.title: Truecell reproduces R Seurat's single-cell analysis outputs natively in the Python ecosystem
items.title_zh: Truecell 在 Python 生态中原生复现 R Seurat 的单细胞分析输出
items.summary_zh: 单细胞 RNA 测序分析主要使用 Seurat（R）或 Scanpy（Python），选择通常由编程语言偏好驱动。然而，默认情况下，这些工具产生不同的可变特征、邻居图、聚类和标记基因。需要 Python（支持大多数深度学习、基础模型和代理工具）的实验室必须在无法复现 Seurat 结果的框架中重新实现 Seurat 分析。Truecell 被开发为 Seurat 接口的 Python 实现，保留函数名称、参数、默认设置和对象模型，以促进分析的无缝转移。在十八个与 R Seurat 的配对端到端评估中，确定性输出匹配到浮点精度，并且折叠变化顺序在所有九个差异表达测试中相同。在三个数据集上的三臂基准测试中，固定用户参数和每个工具 20 个种子，Truecell 在所有 12 个数据集和分辨率设置组合中比配置 Seurat 的 Scanpy 更接近地复现 Seurat 的聚类。Truecell

extra.description: Single-cell RNA-sequencing analyses predominantly use either Seurat (R) or Scanpy (Python), with the choice often driven by programming language preference. However, by default, these tools produce divergent variable features, neighbour graphs, clusters, and marker genes. Laboratories requiring Python, which supports most deep-learning, foundation-model, and agent tools, must re-implement Seurat analyses in a framework that does not replicate Seurat's results. Truecell was developed as a Python implementation of the Seurat interface, preserving function names, arguments, default settings, and the object model to facilitate seamless transfer of analyses. In eighteen paired end-to-end evaluations against R Seurat, deterministic outputs matched to floating-point precision, and fold-change order was identical across all nine differential expression tests. In a three-arm benchmark on three datasets, with fixed user parameters and 20 seeds per tool, Truecell more closely reproduced Seurat's clustering than a Seurat-configured Scanpy in all 12 combinations of dataset and resolution settings. Truecell's marker genes and enriched pathways were also closer to Seurat's than Scanpy's were, and pseudobulk DESeq2 reproduced Seurat's gene lists with a Jaccard index ranging from 0.95 to 1.00. This agreement reflects fidelity to Seurat rather than biological correctness.

items.title: VGL-stGen: Learning a shared multimodal model for lung histology and spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: VGL-stGen：学习肺组织学和空间转录组学的共享多模态模型
items.summary_zh: VGL-stGen是一个多模态大语言模型，从预训练医学视觉-语言模型改编而来，使用配对的肺H&E和空间转录组学及单细胞参考。训练整合了图像-表达和表达-细胞类型配对，基因条件伪标签将转录组细胞类型监督转移到组织学图像。一个部署的检查点支持十三项评估任务，涵盖组织和细胞类型分类、基因预测以及从组织学、细胞身份和观察到的基因表达组合进行条件表达完成。任务特定解码产生分类标签、基因列表和结构化表达水平。对于条件完成，固定查询基因身份并自回归预测其水平可改善结构化预测。受控适应表明，将监督限制在请求的表达水平标记上可以进一步改善图像条件完成。图像置换实验表明，正确配对的组织学增加了超出观察表达的信息。外部分类部分依赖具有共享注释谱系的计算参考，一些H&E来源在癌症训练或模型开发期间被暴露。在这些条件下，VGL-stGen展示了医学视觉-语言骨干如何从空间转录组学和组织学中学习，通过共享生成建模连接

extra.description: VGL-stGen is a multimodal large language model adapted from a pretrained medical vision-language model using paired lung H&E and spatial transcriptomics with single-cell references. Training integrates image-expression and expression-cell-type pairs, and gene-conditioned pseudo-labels transfer transcriptomic cell-type supervision to histology images. One deployed checkpoint supports thirteen evaluated tasks spanning tissue and cell-type classification, gene prediction and conditional expression completion from combinations of histology, cell identity and observed gene expression. Task-specific decoding produces categorical labels, gene lists and structured expression levels. For conditional completion, fixing queried gene identities and predicting their levels autoregressively improves structured prediction. Controlled adaptation shows that restricting supervision to requested expression-level tokens can further improve image-conditioned completion. Image-permutation experiments indicate that correctly paired histology adds information beyond observed expression. External classification relies partly on computational references with shared annotation lineage, and some H&E sources were exposed during cancer training or model development. Within these conditions, VGL-stGen demonstrates how a medical vision-language backbone can learn from spatial transcriptomics and histology to connect tissue morphology and molecular states through shared generative modeling.

items.title: BARRR: Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression for Multi-View Multi-Cohort Data
items.title_zh: BARRR：用于多视图多队列数据的双向增强降秩回归
items.summary_zh: 跨多个队列（即样本组）和视图（即来源或模态）的双向数据整合在生物医学研究中至关重要，以从异质数据集中获得整体见解。然而，大多数现有整合方法侧重于单一维度，如跨不同来源的多视图整合或跨不同样本组的多队列整合。现有的双向整合方法稀缺且主要无监督，忽视了协变量提供的宝贵见解。为解决这一空白，我们引入双向增强降秩回归（baRRR）方法。我们的方法同时建模协变量相关和不相关效应，同时在两个维度上分解效应水平（全局、部分共享和个体）。大量模拟证明了我们的方法在信号恢复、结果预测和缺失数据插补方面的优势。我们将方法应用于癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）数据，使用体细胞突变作为协变量来告知不同组学平台和癌症类型间的变异模式。这些研究突出了其作为生物医学研究中稳健且适应性强的整合分析工具的潜力。

extra.description: Bidimensional data integration across multiple cohorts (i.e., sample groups) and views (i.e., sources or modalities) is crucial in biomedical research to derive holistic insights from heterogeneous datasets. However, most existing integrative methods focus on a single dimension, such as multi-view integration across distinct sources or multi-cohort integration across distinct sample groups. Existing approaches for bidimensional integration are scarce and predominantly unsupervised, overlooking the valuable insights offered by covariates. To address this gap, we introduce the Bidimensional Augmented Reduced Rank Regression (baRRR) method. Our approach models covariate-related and unrelated effects concurrently, while also decomposing effect levels (global, partially shared, and individual) across both dimensions. Extensive simulations demonstrate the advantages of our method with respect to signal recovery, outcome prediction, and missing data imputation. We apply our approach to data from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), using somatic mutations as covariates to inform patterns of variability across different omics platforms and cancer types. These studies highlight its potential as a robust and adaptable tool for integrative analysis in biomedical research.

items.title: Developmental origins of thymic B-cell lymphomas
items.title_zh: 胸腺B细胞淋巴瘤的发育起源
items.summary_zh: 胸腺为淋巴细胞分化提供了特化微环境，但其稀有B细胞群体的发育轨迹及其与胸腺B细胞淋巴瘤发生的关系仍知之甚少。在此，我们整合跨人类组织的单细胞多组学和空间分析，描绘了一个选择性在人类胸腺中呈现的B细胞分化程序。该程序将CCL17和生发中心样B细胞状态连接在一条不同于经典生发中心分化的轨迹上，并可在体外通过胸腺髓质中运作的信号重现。将该框架扩展到人类B细胞淋巴瘤，我们在PMBCL中识别出一个固有的恶性细胞状态，与CCL17胸腺B细胞共享转录和表观遗传特征。该恶性状态与重建的B细胞受体系统发育中的早期克隆位置相关，并持续存在于不同于胸腺微环境的肿瘤微环境中。总之，这些发现支持一个模型，即胸腺特异性B细胞分化程序在胸腺B细胞淋巴瘤发生过程中被重新部署。

extra.description: The thymus provides a specialized niche for lymphocyte differentiation, yet the developmental trajectories of its rare B-cell population and their relationship to thymic B-cell lymphomagenesis remain poorly understood. Here, we integrate single-cell multiomics and spatial profiling across human tissues to delineate a B-cell differentiation program selectively represented in the human thymus. This program links CCL17 and germinal center-like B-cell states along a trajectory distinct from canonical germinal center differentiation and can be recapitulated in vitro by signals operating in the thymic medulla. Extending this framework across human B-cell lymphomas, we identify an inherent malignant cell state in PMBCL that shares transcriptional and epigenetic features with CCL17 thymic B cells. This malignant state associates with early clonal positions in reconstructed B-cell receptor phylogenies and persists within tumor microenvironments distinct from the thymic niche. Together, these findings support a model in which thymus-specific B-cell differentiation programs are redeployed during thymic B-cell lymphomagenesis.

items.title: Reducing double-dipping in single-cell topic models with three-way count splitting
items.title_zh: 用三向计数拆分减少单细胞主题模型中的双重 dipping
items.summary_zh: 主题模型从单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中学习基因程序，然后相同的计数被用于测试哪些基因和供体与这些程序相关。计数拆分是这种复用的标准补救措施，但当编码器读取每个细胞的计数时尚未被测试。在一个104,400细胞的狼疮队列中，每次运行300个置换零基因，朴素检验在名义5%水平下拒绝了36%的零基因-主题对，而通常的两向拆分拒绝了38%，因为编码器看到了被检验基因自身的留出计数。在单独的第三个计数上编码主题使用，使用beta-二项稀疏化，将此降低到7.7%（模型外基因为6.7%）；对于另外两个模型LDVAE和scETM，该率为7.0-7.3%（朴素为51-59%）。一个无标签干扰素程序在狼疮队列和预先指定的COVID-19队列的留出计数中发生偏移，供体水平主题使用预测疾病（AUROC 0.96），超越细胞类型比例（两个队列中分别为0.86和0.58）。校准和预测不依赖于模型。我们不

extra.description: Topic models learn gene programs from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data, and the same counts are then used to test which genes and donors are associated with those programs. Count splitting is the standard remedy for this reuse, but it has not been tested when an encoder reads each cell's counts. On a 104,400-cell lupus cohort with 300 permuted null genes per run, naive tests rejected 36% of null gene-topic pairs at a nominal 5% level, and the usual two-way split rejected 38%, because the encoder sees the tested gene's own held-out count. Encoding topic usage on a separate third of the counts, with beta-binomial thinning, lowered this to 7.7% (6.7% for genes outside the model); for two other models, LDVAE and scETM, the rate was 7.0-7.3% (naive 51-59%). A label-free interferon program shifts in held-out counts in the lupus cohort and in a pre-specified COVID-19 cohort, and donor-level topic usage predicts disease (AUROC 0.96) beyond cell-type proportions (0.86 and 0.58 in the two cohorts). Calibration and prediction did not depend on the model. We do not claim better clustering, prediction or topic stability. Code, figures and result tables are public (MIT license; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23307193).

items.title: Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity
items.title_zh: 理解基因表达到图像学习：空间结构与信息保真度
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）使生物异质性的细胞水平分析成为可能，但从高维、无序基因表达谱学习有效表示仍具挑战性。基因表达到图像（GE2I）通过将基因值排列在像素网格上供卷积神经网络使用，提供了一种有效学习策略，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们在全转录组数据上研究GE2I，同时保持网络和训练过程固定。我们的结果揭示了空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间的权衡。结构化映射产生平滑的低频模式，支持更快的早期优化，而将多个基因分配到同一像素会模糊表达差异并可能降低预测性能。这种权衡解释了为什么当表示许多基因时，随机映射可以与结构化布局竞争。即使图像平滑性降低，一对一基因到像素分配在测试的视觉骨干网络中也能改善预测。我们进一步发现预训练和增强的益处取决于骨干网络和映射。这些发现为像素分配和将视觉先验迁移到基因表达数据提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. This trade-off explains why random mappings can compete with structured layouts when many genes are represented. One-to-one gene-to-pixel assignment improves prediction across the tested visual backbones even when image smoothness decreases. We further find that the benefits of pretraining and augmentation depend on the backbone and mapping. These findings provide practical guidance for pixel allocation and the transfer of vision priors to gene expression data.

items.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
items.title_zh: 细胞命运分配中的预测多重性：无标签 Rashomon 集和逐细胞认证的局限
items.summary_zh: 单细胞轨迹推断将转录组测量映射到发育连续体上，但同样拟合数据的配置可能分配冲突的细胞命运。FateMultiplicity 是一个无标签框架，通过评估交叉拟合留出基因上的模型差异，在非劣效性测试下针对随机种子变异进行校准，构建统计可接受的模型集或 Rashomon 集，无需谱系标签。多重性很大，更多取决于模型空间的多样性而非其大小：第二个算法的十二种配置暴露 20.0% 的细胞，而第一个算法的二十四种配置暴露 3.8%。然后测试逐细胞认证命运边际 FM 是否比拟合模型已提供的产生更可靠的分配，结果并非如此。在模拟真实值上，在相同细胞上，FM 以 AUC 0.682 区分错误分配，而基线配置自身的决策边际为 0.965（p = 0.003），种子离散基线为 0.854。信息量由所接纳集的广度而非其基数决定：在基数四时，种子重拟合给出 0.933，超参数扰动集给出 0.701。将下确界放宽到

extra.description: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
items.title_zh: 感觉运动对齐：具身策略成功的柏拉图式代理指标
items.summary_zh: 机器人基础模型通常通过昂贵的闭环 rollout 评估，这促使人们寻找廉价的离线代理指标来衡量模型能力。柏拉图表示假说（PRH）表明，随着表示改进，视觉和语言等不同模态会收敛到现实的共享统计模型。我们问运动轨迹是否形成另一种这样的模态：随着具身模型能力增强，它们的感官表示是否应收敛到物理运动的结构？为检验这一点，我们提出感觉运动对齐（$S^2$），一种无需训练的离线指标，衡量模型感官表示与物理运动几何的对齐程度。我们发现 $S^2$ 在具身模型家族中与下游机器人任务成功正相关，使其成为在闭环评估前优先排序模型的低成本离线代理指标。$S^2$ 还可以在昂贵的微调为视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）之前识别有前景的视觉-语言模型（VLM）骨干。除这种相关性外，$S^2$ 为 VLA 和世界动作模型（WAM）中观察到的现象提供表示层面的解释。借助 $S^2$，我们将 PRH 扩展到具身模型，并使感觉

extra.description: Robotic foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, which motivates cheap offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, different modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To examine this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment ($S^2$), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that $S^2$ correlates positively with downstream robot task success across embodied model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. $S^2$ can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones even before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, $S^2$ offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With $S^2$, we extend PRH to embodied models and make sensorimotor alignment empirically measurable, offering insight into why an embodied model succeeds beyond its closed-loop success rate.

items.title: EpiSEM-Bench: Evaluating Safety and Evidence Recovery in LLM Agents under Missing Evidence
items.title_zh: EpiSEM-Bench：评估LLM智能体在证据缺失下的安全性与证据恢复
items.summary_zh: 使用工具的语言模型智能体依赖环境事实来决定某个动作是否被允许。当工具响应省略了与安全相关的事实时，智能体可能执行被禁止的动作，即使用户请求是良性的且每个返回的陈述都是真实的。我们提出\bench{}，一个可执行基准，用于评估LLM智能体在证据缺失下的不安全执行、安全边界和证据恢复。它包含跨六个领域的300个匹配的不安全/安全任务对。通过系统性地抑制关键事实，该基准衡量关键证据省略下的不安全执行，并确定观察到的最小失败基数，包括在完整证据下的失败以及在穷尽测试后未观察到失败的情况。一个独立审计工具测试智能体是否寻求缺失事实，然后在完成允许任务的同时扣留被禁止的动作。该基准揭示了十个模型在省略鲁棒性、证据获取和适当行动方面的显著差异。对缺失证据的抵抗力不一定转化为有用的恢复。恢复访问减少了所有十个模型的不安全执行，但智能体在是否主动获取缺失事实并利用它们在两个世界中适当行动方面存在差异。

extra.description: Tool-using language model agents rely on environmental facts to decide whether an action is permitted. When a tool response omits a safety-relevant fact, an agent may carry out a prohibited action even though the user request is benign and every returned statement is true. We introduce \bench{}, an executable benchmark for evaluating unsafe execution, safety boundaries, and evidence recovery in LLM agents under missing evidence. It contains 300 matched unsafe/safe task pairs across six domains. By systematically suppressing critical facts, the benchmark measures unsafe execution under critical evidence omission and determines the minimum observed failure cardinality, including failures with full evidence and cases with no observed failure after exhaustive testing. An independent audit tool tests whether agents seek missing facts and then withhold prohibited actions while completing permissible tasks. The benchmark reveals substantial variation across the ten models in omission robustness, evidence acquisition, and appropriate action. Resistance to missing evidence does not necessarily translate into useful recovery. Recovery access reduces unsafe execution for all ten models, but agents differ in whether they actively obtain the missing facts and use them to act appropriately in both worlds.

items.title: Causal Chain of Thought: Mitigating Attention Leakage via Context Isolation
items.title_zh: 因果思维链：通过上下文隔离缓解注意力泄漏
items.summary_zh: 思维链（CoT）提示引出逐步推理，这些推理似乎解释了模型预测，但无法保证这些步骤因果性地驱动最终答案。在标准自回归生成中，密集注意力允许每个推理步骤关注完整上下文，使模型能够通过直接查找推导出答案，同时生成听起来合理但事后的理由。我们引入CausalCoT，一个推理框架，通过将问题分解为原子子问题的有向无环图来强制因果透明性，在仅包含其直接因果父节点的隔离上下文中评估每个节点。这种马尔可夫结构移除了通往非父节点内容的注意力路径，使下游预测对局部推理敏感，而非全局上下文泄漏。在多样化的推理基准套件中，CausalCoT保持了有竞争力的预测性能，同时提高了解释忠实度，将中间推理步骤的因果敏感性相对于最强基线平均提高12个百分点，最高提高21个百分点。结构化依赖图还支持测试时干预，其中局部修正可预测地传播到下游推理。

extra.description: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting elicits step-by-step rationales that appear to explain model predictions, but there is no guarantee these steps causally drive the final answer. In standard autoregressive generation, dense attention allows each reasoning step to attend to the full context, enabling the model to derive answers through direct lookup while generating plausible-sounding but post-hoc justifications. We introduce CausalCoT, an inference framework that enforces causal transparency by decomposing problems into a directed acyclic graph of atomic sub-questions, evaluating each node in an isolated context containing only its direct causal parents. This Markovian structure removes attention pathways to non-parent content, making downstream predictions sensitive to local reasoning rather than global context leakage. Across a diverse suite of reasoning benchmarks, CausalCoT preserves competitive predictive performance while improving explanation faithfulness, increasing causal sensitivity of intermediate reasoning steps by an average of 12 and up to 21 percentage points over the strongest baseline. The structured dependency graph additionally enables test-time interventions in which local corrections propagate predictably through downstream reasoning.

items.title: BeNice! Closing Looping's Inference-Memory Gap via KV-Sharing
items.title_zh: BeNice！通过KV共享弥合循环架构的推理-内存差距
items.summary_zh: 循环架构通过将激活反复传递通过同一组层来扩展质量，同时保持参数数量固定。在推理期间，每次循环生成独立的KV缓存，导致内存线性增长。为应对这一挑战，先前工作提出了KV共享（即在深度间共享KV缓存），发现在某些情况下，最终循环的KV缓存可以与较早的循环共享而不损失质量，我们将这一性质称为KV可共享性。然而，KV可共享性的底层机制仍知之甚少，即使相同训练的循环架构也不一致地表现出该性质。在本文中，我们研究如何在循环模型中实现KV可共享性。我们提出一种两阶段方法：在第一阶段，我们在预训练期间使用随机深度，这诱导收缩性残差动力学，驱动表示在循环间趋向共同极限。在第二阶段，我们提出BeNice！，一种后训练方法，将最终循环的KV缓存广播到第一个循环，训练其产生兼容的残差，同时保持原始模型的质量。结果，BeNice！实现了KV可共享性，同时匹配标准微调的非共享验证困惑度。使用BeNice！，我们表明KV

extra.description: Looped architectures scale quality while keeping parameter count fixed by repeatedly passing activations through the same block of layers. During inference, each recurrence generates independent KV-caches, causing memory to grow linearly. To address this challenge, prior work has proposed KV-sharing (i.e., sharing KV-caches across depth), finding that, in some cases, the KV-cache of the final recurrence can be shared with the earlier recurrences without quality loss, a property we denote as KV-shareability. However, the mechanisms underlying KV-shareability remain poorly understood, with even identically trained looped architectures not consistently exhibiting it. In this paper, we study how KV-shareability can be enabled in looped models. We propose a two-stage method: in the first stage, we use stochastic depth during pretraining, which induces contractive residual dynamics that drive representations toward a common limit across recurrences. In the second stage, we propose BeNice!, a post-training method that broadcasts the final recurrence's KV-cache into the first recurrence, training it to produce compatible residuals while preserving the original model's quality. As a result, BeNice! enables KV-shareability while matching standard finetuning's unshared validation perplexity. Using BeNice!, we show that KV-sharing is complementary to alternative KV-compression methods, composing with memory-efficient sequence mixers (e.g., multi-latent attention, Kimi delta attention) and low-precision KV-cache quantization (e.g., fp8, mxfp8, nvfp4). Finally, in simulated low-memory, long-context inference, KV-sharing improves cache hit rates by up to 31.4%, increases throughput by up to 23.6%, and reduces p90 time-to-first-token by up to 83.6%.

items.title: Questioning Instrumental Convergence in RLVR: Checkpoint Evidence from OLMo-3
items.title_zh: 质疑RLVR中的工具性收敛：来自OLMo-3的检查点证据
items.summary_zh: 工具性收敛常被援引为一种普遍理由，预期有能力智能体会获取或表达权力寻求子目标：自我保护、资源获取、欺骗或抵抗监督，这对社会构成重要威胁。对于LLM，强化学习是后训练的第一个直接针对目标优化行为的阶段；因此，根据IC理由，这是收敛性工具行为可能出现的阶段。带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）是否使模型更可能表达工具性收敛行为，还是这取决于训练机制、评估框架和后训练阶段？我们将此问题作为检查点条件化的行为轨迹来研究，而非单一的前/后安全分数。使用InstrumentalEval，我们评估OLMo-3-7B-Think在SFT、DPO、13个中间RLVR检查点和最终RLVR模型上的表现。轨迹是非单调的：工具性率从SFT的25.0%上升到RLVR第200步附近的46.1%，然后在最终检查点降至11.8%。配对项目级测试和逐步回归支持最终的SFT到RLVR降低。提示框架不能解释这一模式：有害提示指示符

extra.description: Instrumental convergence is often invoked as a general reason to expect capable agents to acquire or express power-seeking subgoals: self-preservation, resource acquisition, deception, or resistance to oversight which poses an important threat to the society. For LLMs, reinforcement learning is the first stage of post-training that directly optimizes behavior against an objective; therefore, it is the stage where convergent instrumental behavior, on IC grounds, likely to appear. Does reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) make a model more likely to express instrumental-convergence behavior, or does this depend on the training regime, evaluation frame, and stage of post-training? We study this question as a checkpoint-conditioned behavioral trajectory rather than as a single before/after safety score. Using InstrumentalEval, we evaluate OLMo-3-7B-Think across SFT, DPO, 13 intermediate RLVR checkpoints, and the final RLVR model. The trajectory is nonmonotonic: instrumental rate rises from 25.0% at SFT to 46.1% near RLVR step 200, then falls to 11.8% at the final checkpoint. Paired item-level tests and step-wise regression support the final SFT-to-RLVR reduction. Prompt framing does not explain this pattern: a harmful-prompt indicator combined with other framing effects explains only 15% of within-checkpoint score variance on average, and Iterative Null-space Projection (INLP) removes a detectable framing direction without changing the SFT-to-final-RLVR gap. Together with preliminary 32B endpoint results (35.53% SFT to 22.37% RLVR final), these findings indicate that RLVR does not monotonically increase instrumental behavior in this setting: the rate rises early, then falls below the SFT baseline. The result is specific to this model family and benchmark, and judge agreement is moderate, so absolute rates should be read cautiously.

items.title: How Ground Truth Shapes Retrieval Scores: Evidence-Aware Evaluation of a Retrieval-Augmented Generation System for Breast Lesions
items.title_zh: 真实标注如何塑造检索分数：乳腺病变检索增强生成系统的证据感知评估
items.summary_zh: 目的：描述一种针对乳腺病变管理文献的临床检索增强生成（RAG）系统的证据感知检索评估协议，解决检索分数对标注覆盖度的依赖。方法：使用18篇文档语料库和18个查询的开发基准，每篇文档一个是/否或WH问题。检索结合密集嵌入、BM25和交叉编码器重排序。评估了128到1024个令牌的块大小、0到20%的重叠以及四种检索器配置。相关性由映射到所有包含块的证据跨度定义，将具有等效证据的重叠块视为相关。检索使用R-Precision、Recall@K、MRR和nDCG@K评估。另外，在512令牌索引上以K=1到5使用DeepEval声明级指标评估生成，以deepseek-v4-pro作为LLM评判者，并使用BLEU/ROUGE指标。结果：选定的混合检索器使用384令牌块和20%重叠，在18个查询中的17个的前三个结果中检索到接受的证据。Recall@3、R-Precision、MRR@3和nDCG@3

extra.description: Purpose: To describe an evidence-aware retrieval evaluation protocol for a clinical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system over breast lesion management literature, addressing the dependence of retrieval scores on annotation coverage. Methods: An 18-document corpus and an 18-query development benchmark, with one Yes/No or WH-question per document, were used. Retrieval combined dense embeddings, BM25, and cross-encoder reranking. Chunk sizes of 128 to 1024 tokens, overlaps of 0 to 20%, and four retriever configurations were evaluated. Relevance was defined by evidence spans mapped to all containing chunks, treating overlapping chunks with equivalent evidence as relevant. Retrieval was evaluated using R-Precision, Recall@K, MRR, and nDCG@K. Separately, generation was assessed on a 512-token index at K=1 to 5 using DeepEval claim-level metrics, with deepseek-v4-pro as the LLM judge, and BLEU/ROUGE metrics. Results: The selected hybrid retriever, using 384-token chunks and 20% overlap, retrieved accepted evidence in the top three results for 17 of 18 queries. Recall@3, R-Precision, MRR@3, and nDCG@3 each reached 0.94. Ground-truth curation increased evidence spans from 25 to 37 and accepted chunk targets from 36 to 51 without changing retrieval rankings. Conclusion: Cross-encoder reranking achieved the highest retrieval scores. Expanded relevance annotations increased recognized evidence without changing rankings, highlighting annotation sensitivity. The small development set and retrieval-informed curation require independent validation, including radiologist assessment of evidence sufficiency.

items.title_zh: 国务院办公厅称要「有效减缓人工智能应用就业替代影响」，释放出什么信号？可能带来哪些实际影响？
items.summary_zh: 10月23日，国务院办公厅印发《关于适应人工智能技术发展助力构建就业友好型发展方式的意见》。其中指出，减缓人工智能应用就业替代影响，努力实现技术进步、产业升级与就业促进、民生改善相协调的包容性发展。 在减缓人工智能应用就业替代影响方面，《意见》指出，发挥人工智能在改善就业环境、提升职业安全水平、提高工作质效等方面的作用，优先在劳动力紧缺、环境高危等岗位推广应用。 稳慎把握人工智能在劳动密集型行业应用的范围、力度、节奏，尽可能减少对从业人员的冲击。鼓励企业探索建立失业缓冲期制度，在大规模推广应用人工智能过程中提前告知受影响劳动者、提供转型转岗就业支持。 此次发布的《意见》部署了6个方面18项主要任务。 一是强化人工智能的就业创造效应。拓展新兴领域人工智能就业新空间，培育中小微企业稳岗扩岗新动能，创造人工智能领域就业创业新模式，加快开发人工智能领域新职业。 二是构建就业友好型人工智能升级路径。

items.title: 男孩偷超市饮料，被父亲拿着戒尺送到派出所「自首」，感受手铐重量后向店主道歉，你支持这种教育方式吗？
items.title_zh: 男孩偷超市饮料，被父亲拿着戒尺送到派出所「自首」，感受手铐重量后向店主道歉，你支持这种教育方式吗？
items.summary_zh: 近日，湖北宜昌。一男孩偷拿超市饮料藏进校服，被父亲拿着戒尺送到派出所“自首”。 事发10月15日傍晚6时许，男孩放学途中路过小区门口的超市时，趁店主招呼其他顾客的间隙，从门口冷藏柜里拿了一瓶冰红茶，悄悄塞进衣服里带回了家。 他自以为藏得隐蔽，没想到很快就被父亲发现了，得知原委后，这位父亲做出了一个出人意料的决定，牵着孩子的手直奔派出所。 “小事不能小视，错了就要认账。”在父亲看来，哪怕只是一瓶几块钱的饮料也不能让孩子形成“不经允许偷拿别人东西无所谓” 的认知。 了解事情经过后，值班民警把男孩叫到身旁，蹲下身来看着孩子的眼睛，一字一句地说道：“勿以恶小而为之，今天拿一瓶饮料是小事，可一旦养成了习惯，长大了就可能犯下大错。” 说着，民警拿出一副手铐，轻轻放在男孩的手上。“你现在年纪小，犯了错还有改正的机会，等你到16岁、18岁，再犯错误戴上它，就不是今天这样的性质了。”男孩看着认真地点了点头。

items.title_zh: 9 月日产本田在华销量均跌超五成，为何日系车遭遇大幅下滑？
items.summary_zh: 数据显示，日产9月国内新车销量为23658辆，同比下滑61.6%，已连续六个月同比走低。本田9月销量为25564辆，同比降幅达53.1%，销量下滑周期已拉长至32个月。8月末，本田与日产敲定合作协议，共同研发车载操作系统与车载计算硬件。该技术方案预计最早2029年落地新车，支持远程OTA升级，可适配燃油、混动、纯电多种车型，三菱汽车有望后续接入该技术体系。两家车企于2024年开启智能化方向前期研究，曾推进合并谈判，整合计划于2025年宣告终止，之后转向项目层面的技术协作。财报方面，2025财年，本田全球销量同比回落8.8%，净亏损约178.3亿元人民币；日产全球销量下滑5.8%，亏损规模约224.3亿元人民币。 【网通社快报】日产与本田9月在华销量同比下滑均超五成 双方合作研发车载系统_凤凰网【网通社快报】日产与本田9月在华销量同比下滑均超五成 双方合作研发车载系统
